newsitem.title: singapore: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were narrowly mixed in moderate trade with most traders sidelined before today's issue of the U.S. weekly jobless claims and February retail sales data, dealers said on Thursday.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended March 8 are forecast to be around 313,000 compared with 310,000 reported in the previous week.
Retail sales for February are expected to be unchanged from January's increase of 0.6 percent.
"Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning on some position adjustments," a local dealer said.

"Some people are waiting for fresh direction from tonight's release of the weekly jobless claims and retail sales figures. But I don't think there will be much impact as the numbers have been built into the market and most people have squared or are squaring their positions," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday and weekend eased 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, six-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 percent.
